name: Rio Server
description: The codes the Project Rio server offers players. A deliberate selection: a code is in this list only because it is named below, so adding a file to Gecko Codes/ never publishes it by accident.
install: This list is read by the Rio server, not installed by hand. gecko_codes.json is the machine-readable form; gecko_codes.txt is the plain layout the in-service list has always used. GYQE01.ini is the same codes as a Dolphin ini, all switched off.

_notes: Seeded 2026-09-17 from the 102 codes in service at the time (docs/in_service_import.md maps
each one to its file). Custom Music is absent on purpose: it is baked into the RioModPack DOL
and is not a standalone gecko code. Manual Fielder Select is the repo's v5, not the older
Y/X/R/Z version that was in service.
Ships OFF because it is a catalog: several entries hook the same site and cannot be on
together (the Boot to ... codes, Default N Innings, Ban vs Restrict Batter Pausing, Input
Prediction vs Batter Lag Reduction, the Hazardless variants). To stop offering a code, delete
its line; to offer a new one, add its path. BuildCodeList.py --check fails on a path that no
longer exists, so a rename cannot silently drop a code from the server.
